buffer_policy: health set then one output-data-weight Y08 set reused for all shape-compatible candidates
failure_policy: health fail stops; candidate first error rejects; timed error stops

protocol.baseline_scope: Random/bytes/calls are explicit controls, not reproductions of Rieber, XGB or ML2Tuner
protocol.deadline: no new phase after deadline; running step drains; all overrun charged; late labels excluded
protocol.eligibility: real lowering plus three seed FSim; candidate FPGA result admitted only after three seed correctness and seven paired rounds
protocol.failure: preserve failures and no candidate replacement
protocol.oracle: post-collection evaluation only, never online stopping
protocol.scope: new tile/residency candidate pool; historical full-network stock executions exposed
protocol.status_if_no_candidates: record real compiler/FSim failure reasons; no performance claims
protocol.target: Y08 YOLOv3-tiny conv12 CI512 CO1024 H13 W13 K3
protocol.timing: Each prospective policy must time a complete outer pipeline, including model preparation, qualification, selection, build, clean start, upload, allocation and measurement. Local qualification discovery run alone is not such a measurement.

search_policy_execution: forbidden; full pool labels only; P7R355 policies evaluated later
